conciseReport:
# TEST2-90 · cycle-002

21 canonical criteria: 9 Passed, 1 Failed, 6 Unverified, 5 Blocked. Tested Automobile / Call on the configured V4 development host using Google Chrome 156.0.8078.48.

Direct failure: 5G NSA appears in both the Call CSR legend and technology filter (criterion 19).

Map selection, selector choices, CSR/MOS shapes, restored metric/legend state, cluster columns/sorting and a genuine zero-duration no-data message were evidenced. Weighted calculations, exact runtime boundaries, complete marker/scope invariance and out-of-range MOS remain limited by the observed fixtures. Marker-size controls and related Service Details fixtures were unavailable; cross-instance isolation and Service-tab behaviour remain unverified.

SIMULATED UI STATE: criterion 21 injected one scoped HTTP 503 for POST /api/platform/automobile/call/cluster-details, PointID 132006263. The correct target showed Unable to load Call details with no stale definitions from distinct record 132047844. The owned route was removed in finally, zero pending requests were verified, and genuine HTTP 200 recovery succeeded. This does not establish backend error behaviour; the Service branch remains Blocked.

395 saved PNGs were decoded and verified non-empty inside this handoff's staging folder. Evidence references are criterion-specific and ordered; cleanup captures are separate. Original Ping layer, existing Ping tab, legend values/visibility and map zoom were restored. No permanent ticket/report, Jira, authentication or backend changes were made.
reason: Blocked prerequisites remain despite 9 evidenced passes; one direct product contradiction and six inconclusive criteria require evidence review. Synthetic point-detail UI testing is explicitly disclosed; Service data and calculation/boundary fixtures are still needed.
